subject: Re: Project Kestrel — memo decision + scope call
body:
Team,

Decisions for the Kestrel close-out:

1. The decision memo recommends replacing 30% of the web-crawled de-en training slice with MBR-decoded NewsPaLM data, blob-level where the downstream task is document translation. The +2.1 BLEURT with a dedup-hardened baseline is a defensible number, and Ondrej's methodology section makes that case explicitly.
2. Scope call: the en-de direction ships in the memo as preliminary (the dedup delay means only half its ablation cells finish by 05-25). I'd rather flag it than pad the timeline. Full en-de results become a Q3 fast-follow.
3. The beyond-en/de recipe ships as an appendix — Kaia's granularity finding is the piece I want quoted when other portfolios pick this up.

Memo review Tuesday, final to Hana's staff by 05-22, closing Kestrel on schedule.

Excellent work, all.

Dmitri
